description: Dear Colorado Voter, With 4 weeks left, I am now spending the money that you all have so generously donated. A billboard on I-25. New campaign literature so I can succinctly introduce myself. Online advertising. (Check out your favorite Colorado town at https://www.ourconnectedcommunities.com/CO .) More in-state travel. Possibly a movie screening of the 2012 Chilean film “No” – maybe on my birthday. The best birthday present would be 1.5 million Coloradans voting for me!Please share your ideas f
